question: OWLS is related to TRPO in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, YMTK is related to DHXG. To which of the following is ICBC related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, OWLS is related to TRPO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d9f13dc33b332b85b83302b62f5870f1b676fdee928f18b2b1e41404ec01a26.png] 

For, YMTK is related to DHXG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69f057671f4ea159c2d77e64f46a3c3a94c83f49b2badcc087570eb1d2c3756e.png] 

Similarly, for **ICBC**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe9d3031c345e5e2f433f9d5393d9501970bcbd6182709b2c171cd975214889e.png] 

So, ICBC will be related to **NXFY.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
